overview_description.description: Arabian Combustion Technologies (ACT) is a KAUST spinout company focused on using world leading research to improve the environmental impact of combustion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally. ACT operates in partnership with novel technology providers while developing manufacturing capabilities and creating high value employment for the local talent pool in the Kingdom.
